meta.title: Board update: Q3 results and the plan for Q4

slides.title: Q3 beat plan on revenue but missed on churn, so Q4 shifts effort from acquisition to retention

points.headline: Revenue finished 4% above plan
points.detail: New business was strong in the mid-market; enterprise deals slipped to Q4.

points.headline: Net revenue retention fell below 100% for the first time
points.detail: Churn is concentrated in customers on the legacy plan who never adopted the new reporting module.

points.headline: Cash runway is 21 months at the current burn
points.detail: No new financing is needed before the next board cycle.

points.headline: Q4 moves two sales engineers to customer success
points.detail: The goal is to migrate every legacy customer before renewal.

points.headline: We ask the board to approve the revised Q4 targets
points.detail: Revenue target unchanged; retention target added.

slides.title: New business carried the quarter while expansion revenue shrank
takeaways: New business is up a third since Q4 25
Expansion has fallen three quarters in a row
Expansion is where retention problems show first

slides.title: Customers on the legacy plan churn at four times the rate of everyone else
Every Q3 metric except retention is on or ahead of plan
Approve three changes to the Q4 plan

items.action: Add a net revenue retention target of 102%
Move two sales engineers to customer success
Migrate all legacy-plan customers before renewal
items.detail: Free migration, no price change for 12 months
